identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase I Clinical Study of CD70-targeting CAR-T Therapy in the Treatment of CD70-positive Advanced/Metastatic Solid Tumors

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This is a single-center, double-arm, open-label study. The study plans to set up 2 groups,Intravenous infusion group have 4 dose groups, adopting a dose-escalating 3+3 design, and plan to recruit about 12 subjects with CD70-positive advanced/metastatic solid tumors.Intraperitoneal injection group have 4 dose groups, adopting a dose-escalating 3+3 design, and plan to recruit about 12 subjects with CD70-positive advanced/metastatic solid tumors.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence of Adverse events after CD70 CAR-T cells infusion [Safety and Tolerability]
primaryOutcomes.description: Therapy-related adverse events were recorded and assessed according to the National Cancer Institute's Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE, Version 5.0)

primaryOutcomes.measure: Obtain the maximum tolerated dose of CD70 CAR-T cells[Safety and Tolerability]

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Disease control rate of CAR-T cell preparations in CD70 positive advanced malignancies [Effectiveness]
secondaryOutcomes.description: Disease control rate: including CR, PR and SD

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Objective response rate (ORR) of CD70 CAR-T treatment in patients with CD70-positive advanced malignancies[Effectiveness]
Duration of Response (DOR) of CD70 CAR-T treatment in patients with CD70-positive advanced malignancies[Effectiveness]
secondaryOutcomes.description: DOR will be assessed from the first assessment of CR/PR/SD to the first assessment of recurrence or progression of the disease or death from any cause

secondaryOutcomes.measure: AUCS of CD70 CAR-T cells [Cell dynamics]
secondaryOutcomes.description: AUCS is defined as the area under the curve in 28 days and 90 days

secondaryOutcomes.measure: CMAX of CD70 CAR-T cells [Cell dynamics]
secondaryOutcomes.description: CMAX is defined as the highest concentration of CD70 CAR-T cells expanded in peripheral blood

secondaryOutcomes.measure: TMAX of CD70 CAR-T cells[Cell dynamics]
secondaryOutcomes.description: TMAX is defined as the time to reach the highest concentration

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Pharmacodynamics of CD70 CAR-T cells[Cell dynamics]
secondaryOutcomes.description: Concentration levels of CAR-T-related serum cytokines such as CRP, IL-6, ferritin at each time point

otherOutcomes.measure: The correlation between CD70 positive rate and safety
otherOutcomes.description: assessment the correlation between CD70 positive rate and the incidence of CRA and ICANS

otherOutcomes.measure: Correlation between CD70 positive rate and efficacy
otherOutcomes.description: assessment the correlation between CD70 positive rate and the disease control rate，Disease control rate: including CR, PR and SD

otherOutcomes.measure: Overall survival(OS)of CD70 CAR-T treatment in patients with CD70-positive advanced malignancies[Effectiveness]
otherOutcomes.description: OS will be assessed from the first CD70-CAR-T cell infusion to death from any cause (Assessed by investigators based on IRECIST criteria)

otherOutcomes.measure: Progress-free survival(PFS) of CD70 CAR-T treatment in patients with CD70-positive advanced malignancies[Effectiveness]
otherOutcomes.description: PFS will be assessed from the first CD70-CAR-T cell infusion to death from any cause or the first assessment of progression (Assessed by investigators based on IRECIST criteria)

otherOutcomes.measure: Duration of Response (DOR) of CD70 CAR-T treatment in patients with CD70-positive advanced malignancies[Effectiveness]
otherOutcomes.description: DOR will be assessed from the first assessment of CR/PR/SD to the first assessment of recurrence or progression of the disease or death from any cause (Assessed by investigators based on IRECIST criteria)
